bullets: Features should be on the same scale

labels: Replace x_im by z_im = (x_im − x̄_m)/σ_m (make them zero mean, unit variance)

σ_m^2 = (1/N) Σ_{i=1}^{N} (x_im − x̄_m)^2 : empirical variance of m^th feature
